newsitem.title: CANADA: William Resources raises C$5.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: William Resources raises C$5.9 mln.

text.p: William Resources Inc said on Friday that ScotiaMcLeod Inc exercised an option to buy 3.3 million of its shares for more than C$5.9 million for resale to the public.
The 3.3 million shares were in addition to 16.7 million common shares underwritten earlier this week by ScotiaMcLeod, the company said.
ScotiaMcLeod is to pay C$1.80 for each additional share or C$5.94 million.
The underwriting of 20 million shares will mean total proceeds of C$36 million for William, the company said.
About C$25 million will be used to finance capital expenditures and repay debt from the acquisiton of the Jacobina mine in Brazil.
The rest will be used for future acquisitions, the company said.
